segments.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: סְתָם תְּרוּמָה בִּיהוּדָה כּוּ׳. הָא מַכִּירִין — אֲסוּרִין, אַלְמָא סְפֵיקָא לְחוּמְרָא.
segments.en: § It is stated in the mishna that «Rabbi Yehuda says: Unspecified teruma in Judea» is forbidden, but in the Galilee it is permitted, as the people of the Galilee are unfamiliar with the collection of the Temple treasury chamber. The Gemara infers: Where «they are familiar» with the collection of the chamber, it is «forbidden. Apparently, uncertainty» with regard to vows «is» treated «stringently.»
